subject: Web Development
subcategory: Famous Websites That Changed the World
title: LinkedIn: The Professional Network
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on LinkedIn: The Professional Network.

hook.text: Reid Hoffman launched LinkedIn in 2003 to bring professional networking online.

buildup.text: Users created digital resumes, connected with colleagues, and searched for jobs.

discovery.text: Recruiters adopted it rapidly. LinkedIn became the default way to find and vet job candidates.

twist.text: Microsoft bought LinkedIn for $26.2 billion — the largest tech acquisition at the time.

climax.text: LinkedIn turned the resume from a paper document into a living, searchable profile.

punchline.text: A website replaced the paper resume forever.
